en-US.title: FlyRight: Flight Compensation
en-US.subtitle: Get paid for flight delays
en-US.description:
FlyRight watches your flights and tells you the moment a delay or cancellation makes you eligible for airline compensation — and exactly how much you are owed.

Add a flight in seconds. FlyRight tracks it and applies EU261 air passenger rights to every disruption. If your delayed or cancelled flight qualifies, you get a clear verdict — up to €600 per passenger — and a ready-to-send claim letter.

• Track your flights with live status
• Instant EU261 compensation verdicts
• See exactly how much you are owed
• Generate a ready-to-send claim letter
• Deadline reminders so you never miss a claim window
• No account needed — sign in only to keep purchases across devices

Delayed three hours or more, cancelled last minute, or denied boarding on an EU flight? Airlines owe you real money. FlyRight makes sure you collect it.

Privacy policy: https://getflyright.com/privacy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://getflyright.com/terms
en-US.releaseNotes:
The biggest FlyRight update yet:

• Scan your boarding pass — point the camera at any pass and the flight is added instantly.
• World map — every journey you've flown, drawn as flight routes on a zoomable globe-style map.
• Earlier delay warnings — FlyRight watches your aircraft's inbound rotation and can flag a likely delay before departure.
• Apple Watch — your travel day now appears in the Smart Stack on your wrist.
• Redesigned Add flight with a proper calendar and boarding-pass styling.
• Claim tracking — record airline replies (acknowledged, paid, rejected) and re-read the exact claim email you sent.
• Save past flights straight to My travels, smarter airport search, side-by-side layout on iPad, and lots of polish and fixes.

review.notes:
FlyRight 1.0.18 — feature update (new: boarding-pass scanner, World map tab, inbound-aircraft delay prediction, Apple Watch Smart Stack support, redesigned Add flight, claim outcome tracking).

DEMO ACCOUNT — HOW TO SIGN IN: Settings tab -> 'Sign in or create account' -> enter the email above -> tap Continue -> tap 'Use another method' -> 'Sign in with your password' -> enter the password. No email code is needed for this account. (The demo password is maintained directly in App Store Connect, not in this file.)

This account's FlyRight Pro subscription (promotional, yearly entitlement) has already EXPIRED, so the expired-subscription purchase flow is reviewable: Settings -> 'Get FlyRight Pro' shows the paywall again, and Restore purchases finds no active purchase. New purchases can be tested with the App Store sandbox as usual.

Notes:
- The app is fully usable without sign-in; purchases are device/receipt based (RevenueCat). The account only backs up travel history and links web purchases.
- The boarding-pass scanner requires the camera; any airline boarding pass (paper or screen) with a PDF417/Aztec barcode works. Flights can always be added manually with just a flight number.
- The camera/location usage strings are declared; the app never requests location (a bundled notification SDK references the API, hence the notice).
